Carrick Metals Appoints New Chief Executive to Lead Guernsey Operations

Carrick Metals, a leading player in the European mining sector, has announced the appointment of Laura Forrester as Chief Executive Officer for its Guernsey-based operations. The move comes as the company seeks to strengthen its management team amid growing interest in the island’s metals and mining industry.

Forrester, who previously served as Chief Operating Officer at Bramble Resources, brings over two decades of industry experience to her new role. Her appointment follows the retirement of outgoing CEO Peter Marsh, who held the position for the past seven years.

“I am honoured to join Carrick Metals at such a pivotal time for the industry in Guernsey,” Forrester said in a statement released Tuesday. “With rising demand for responsibly sourced minerals, we are well-positioned to build on our reputation for operational excellence and sustainable practices.”

Carrick Metals employs more than 300 staff in the Channel Islands, with its Guernsey site focused on extraction and processing of base metals for European manufacturing clients. While the company does not disclose production figures, industry analysts estimate it contributes roughly 15% of the island’s annual mineral output.

The Guernsey Chamber of Commerce welcomed Forrester’s appointment, noting her “impressive track record and commitment to community engagement.” Chamber President Mark Le Page commented, “Local mining is an important contributor to Guernsey’s economy. We look forward to continued collaboration with Carrick Metals under Ms. Forrester’s leadership.”

Analysts say the appointment signals Carrick Metals’ intention to expand its presence in the region. “Laura Forrester’s expertise in supply chain management and stakeholder relations will be invaluable as the company navigates evolving environmental regulations and shifting global demand,” said Amy Guille, a metals sector analyst at Channel Insights.

The company has recently invested in new processing technology aimed at reducing environmental impact and improving recovery rates. Forrester indicated she would continue to prioritize sustainability initiatives, stating, “Our commitment to responsible mining is unwavering. We will keep working closely with local authorities to ensure our operations align with Guernsey’s environmental goals.”

With global metals markets in a period of steady growth, industry observers anticipate further investment and job creation in Guernsey’s mining sector over the coming year.
